Summary: I wrote `$Gson$TypesAgentTest`, a self-contained JUnit 4 test class (matching the `junit-4.12.jar`/`hamcrest` present in `lib/`) covering every field and method documented in the `$Gson$Types` javadoc — `EMPTY_TYPE_ARRAY`, `arrayOf`, `subtypeOf`, `supertypeOf`, `canonicalize`, `equals`, `getRawType`, `typeToString`, `getArrayComponentType` (incl. its documented `ClassCastException`), `getCollectionElementType` (incl. its documented `IllegalArgumentException`), `getMapKeyAndValueTypes`, `newParameterizedTypeWithOwner`, and the package-private helpers `equal`, `hashCodeOrZero`, `checkNotPrimitive`, `getGenericSupertype`, `getSupertype`, `resolve`, and `resolveTypeVariable` (reachable since the test lives in the same package). Fixtures (`Box<T>`, `IntegerSet`) are nested inside the test file, and assertions target documented return values/boundary behavior rather than just "no exception."
